clean-up.name: Clean Up
clean-up.body:
An allied |*Agent Venom| and allied |*Peter Parker| may each spend 1 |!power| to play this card during the |*Power Phase|.|\|
|*Agent Venom| gains the |*Spider-Sense| |!innate| superpower until the end of the round.|\|
clean-up.intermediaryBody: |*Peter Parker| gains the |*Symbiotic Instincts| |!innate| superpower until the end of the round.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.

superPowers.name: Symbiotic Instincts
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, the defending character cannot modify its defense dice.

stolen-power-of-cyttorak.name: Stolen Power of Cyttorak
stolen-power-of-cyttorak.body:
During |*Onslaught|'s Activation, he may play this card.|\|
|*Onslaught| gains the |*Nothing Stops Onslaught| |!active| superpower until the end of this Round.

superPowers.name: Nothing Stops Onslaught
superPowers.body: Push this character |!movement_small|. It does not stop its movement if it contacts a |!size| 4 or smaller interactive terrain feature. Instead, the contacted terrain feature is destroyed, then this character continues being Pushed. If this character contacts 1 or more other characters, choose 1 contacted character. The chosen character suffers 1 |!damage|. Then this character stops as normal. A character can be damaged by this superpower only once per Turn.

venomized.name: Venomized
venomized.body:
An allied character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card during its Activation.|\|
For the rest of the game, the character that played this card lowers its |!energy| defense stat by 2, to a minimum of 1.|\|
For the rest of the game, the character that played this card gains the attack shown above.

attacks.name: We Are Hungry
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each |!damage| dealt.
